telescope_info.source: support.itelescope.net/support/solutions/articles/231903-telescope-11, "iTelescope - T11 - Deep Space - Utah", modified Wed, 1 Mar, 2023, 1:04 PM
lines: Observatory: Utah Desert Remote Observatory, Great Basin Desert, Beryl Junction, Utah, USA; MPC U94
Telescope: 0.50-m f/6.8 reflector + CCD + f/4.5 focal reducer
Min target elevation: 15° all azimuths except 19° for azimuths 240-300°

Ops notes: deep field, hybrid missions, photometry and imaging, FITS and TIF; darks 60/120/180/300/600 s Bin 1 and 2; recommended max exposure 600 s; raw data at data.itelescope.net; 0.66 focal reducer; Planewave Ascension 200HR mount, active guidance disabled; 300-600 s unguided, to mag 21.5

CCD: FLI ProLine PL11002M, QE 51% peak, full well ~60,000 e- with anti-blooming, dark <.03 e-/px/s at -35 C, 9 µm pixels, 0.81 arcsec/pixel, frontlit, cooling -30 C default, 4008x2672 (10.7 MP), FOV 36.2 x 54.3 arcmin, position angle 186.9°
Filters: AstroDon L, R, G, B; 3nm Ha3_50R, Sii3_50R, Oiii_50R; U, B, V, R, I
Optics: Planewave 20" (0.51 m) CDK, aperture 510 mm, focal length 2280 mm with 0.66 reducer, f/4.5; guiding disabled; mount Planewave Ascension 200HR

Transformation coefficients (NGC 7790): Tub 1.086 (.009), Tbv 1.106 (.018), Tvr 1.057 (.017), Tri 0.933 (.006), Tu 0.103 (.014), Tb 0.017 (.006), Tv -0.133 (.010), Tr -0.211 (.019); Astrometrica T11 config file linked

workflow: Planning Tool or Telescopius for coordinates/visibility
check framing in Telescopius with correct telescope
fill Deep Sky Objects form, suggested H:M:S / D:M:S (RA 05:23:25 DEC -10:12:56)
master calibration: Bias Bin 1 & 2, Darks 60, 120, 180, 300, 600, 900 s Bin 1 & 2, exposure times must match
Acquire images now or Create plan for later (Reservation)
watch via System Status or View Desktop
tips: stack many shorter subs (120 s x 10 = 1200 s master
single 1200 s only marginally better in perfect conditions)
sky shot noise just exceeding dark current is ideal
brighter object shorter sub, darker filter longer
prefer #REPEAT over Qty (4x LRGB 1200 s cut at 3/4 gives L,R,G no B
notes: adaptive focus periodically and on temperature change, disabled by #FORCESTARTUP + #NOADAPTIVE.
Outputs: raw 16-bit FITS, calibrated 16-bit FITS (bias if required, dark, flat), JPEG preview, optional 16-bit TIFF, optional calibrated FITS to VPhot..
